sentences.en: Peasants often have a secondary activity to augment their income.
sentences.zh: 农民通常会有第二份工作来增加收入。

sentences.en: "All secondary schools are the same", I thought to myself.
sentences.zh: 我觉得所有的中等学校都一样。

sentences.en: Languages are meant for communication and understanding. Correctness is secondary.
sentences.zh: 语言是用来交流和理解的工具。正确性只是其次的问题。

senses.zh: 次要的，第二位的；中等的，第二流的；继发的，派生的；中级的，中等教育的
